given: the analytics capability and the finance.manage_folio masking pattern exist only on feat/folio-payments, not on main
then: blocks: s1. Resolved by building on feat/folio-payments, where analytics exists; the pull request targets that branch until analytics reaches main. The portfolio gates a Property by the analytics capability and masks money as getPropertyAnalytics does

given: a Staff Member reaching at least one Property, whatever their role
then: no new permission: the analytics pattern applies, because the analytics screen already lets every reader see operational figures and masks money behind finance.manage_folio, and Owner and Manager and Finance are the holders of finance.manage_folio so a portfolio.read permission would add a migration and no new reader. They get one row per reached Property

given: a Staff Member with organization_wide reach in an Organization of five active Properties
then: five rows come back

given: a Staff Member assigned two of five Properties
then: two rows come back and the other three are absent, with no count and no placeholder

situation: A Property they do not reach
given: a Property of the same Organization the Staff Member is not assigned to
then: it is absent, indistinguishable from a Property that does not exist

given: a Property whose status is archived
when: an organization_wide Owner asks for the portfolio
then: it is absent: app.accessible_property_ids() admits only active Properties (ADR 0040)

given: a signed-in user with no membership, or a membership reaching no active Property
then: an empty list comes back and no error says why

given: a Staff Member reaching one Property
then: one row comes back; the backend does not refuse a single-Property viewer, the screen decides whether to show the destination

given: the Organization's Subscription is past_due
then: the rows come back: past_due is a grace period that gate 1 admits (ADR 0040)

given: the Subscription is suspended or cancelled
then: an empty list comes back, the same answer as having nothing

given: two reached Properties, the analytics capability enabled for one and not the other
then: both rows come back; the second is marked not entitled with every figure null, so an Owner sees it was withheld instead of concluding it is missing

given: a Property entitled to the portfolio but without the maintenance capability
then: its open-maintenance figure is null, never 0, because a zero reads as nothing open; the other figures are unaffected

given: a reader without finance.manage_folio
then: occupancy and the counts come back, every money figure is null on every row

given: two Properties whose currencies differ, which ADR 0036 allows
then: each row carries its own currency and its own balance, and the response holds no money total that adds across currencies

given: two Properties with 10 of 20 and 30 of 40 units occupied
then: the total is 40 occupied of 60 sellable as counts, not the average of two percentages and not a rounded percentage

given: a Property with units out of order
when: occupied and sellable units are counted
then: sellable units are leaf units (no child unit, ADR 0025) except a unit whose own status is out_of_service or whose room is, with no in-house Stay (ADR 0032, a room out of order holds its beds); an in-house unit is always counted, so occupied never exceeds sellable. A blocked unit stays sellable

given: a Property with no rooms or every unit out of order
then: sellable is 0 and occupied is 0 and the backend computes no ratio; the screen shows a dash and says no sellable units, and Analytics shows no occupancy for a Property with no Stay either (ANALYTICS-10)

given: a Property with three Reservations due today, one already checked in
then: arrivals still to come is 2, counted on that Property's own business date

given: a Property with two in-house Stays due out today or overdue and one already checked out
then: departures still to come is 2: Stays still in house whose end date is today or earlier, so an overdue Stay counts because it still has to leave; one already checked out does not

given: a Property with requests in open and done states
then: the figure counts requests not yet done or cancelled; the exact statuses are an open fact to read from the maintenance module, not guessed

given: a Property whose Folios carry charges, payments and reversals
then: the figure is the sum of positive Folio balances, each balance a sum of lines (ADR 0015), so a reversed charge (ADR 0041) and a recorded payment lower it

given: two Properties in different time zones, one already past midnight
then: each row is evaluated on its own business date (ADR 0021) and carries that date; there is no portfolio-wide today

given: a Property whose wall clock passed midnight and whose business day has not closed
then: the figures belong to the open business date, not the calendar date (ADR 0034)

given: two Properties with a check-in committing between their reads
then: every row is read in one SQL statement, so the whole answer shares one snapshot, and is stamped with as_of, so the comparison cannot straddle the check-in

given: a Staff Member of Organization A and Properties of Organization B
then: no row of Organization B appears

given: a Staff Member active in two Organizations, and a read that names one Organization id
then: rows come only from the Organization named, never both; the application has no active-Organization concept, so the read takes the Organization id, and deleting that filter must fail a test because accessible_property_ids() spans both

given: a Resident signed in to the Portal
then: nothing comes back

given: Properties with equal names, and names differing in case
then: order is by name then id, the same on every read

given: an Organization reaching more than 200 Properties
then: the read is refused with a typed error, never silently truncated, because a comparison missing rows is worse than none

given: one, two and twelve reached Properties
then: the answer is one statement over the reached Properties whatever their number, so the gates are set-based and not a loop of the single-Property reads

given: a returned row
when: the screen offers to open that Property
then: the row carries the Property id, which is what the switcher takes

given: a Property is unassigned after the first read
then: the second read omits it; nothing is cached across requests

given: a check-in reversed after the Guest was counted occupied (ADR 0022)
then: occupied units no longer include that Guest

given: a read made without withOrganizationContext
then: policies see a null user and return nothing, so it fails as empty instead of leaking

given: any request for the portfolio
then: portfolio.viewed is logged with actor, Organization, Property count and outcome ok or empty or refused or failed, including when the read throws; it carries counts only, never a figure or a Property name. The workspace has no semantic-event sink yet, so this is a structured console.info and console.error as its other reads do, and an Observatory sink is a later change

given: the mockup's Charged this month tile
then: deferred: it needs a definition first, which month and whether reversals net out (ADR 0015 and 0041)

given: the mockup's sparkline
then: deferred: the mockup draws it from a sine of the Property id so no real series exists

given: Properties in different currencies
then: deferred: it needs a rate source and a rule for which date's rate

given: an archived Property with financial history
when: an Owner wants it in the portfolio
then: deferred: ADR 0040 says this is a new read-only path decided when reporting exists, not a widening of accessible_property_ids()

given: the contract exists
then: out_of_scope for this card: empty, one, many, loading, refused, every locale and RTL are the screen's rows, designed when it is built

given: a Staff Member reaching several Properties of one Organization with analytics enabled at one of them
then: All Properties is in the rail's management section and the route opens. A viewer reaching one Property per Organization is not offered it: there is nothing to line up. The shell derives the entry from what the viewer reaches (lib/portfolio-offer.ts); it is not a capability a Property switches on. Hiding is not the boundary: the read gates every Property again

given: the mockup places All Properties with multi-Property Organizations and the owner has not decided whether it needs an Enterprise plan
when: an Organization on a lower plan reaches several Properties
then: no plan gate is built: reach and analytics alone decide, so every such Organization sees it. Question for the owner: should the portfolio be an Entitlement of its own or Enterprise-only, and what does a lower plan see in its place? Proposed answer: no gate until the plan story is decided with ADR 0040's Subscription rules

given: a viewer reaching exactly one Property of the Organization read (a typed URL; the rail does not offer it)
then: it says there is nothing to compare, names the Property and offers Go to Today at it; no card and no summary, because one Property beside nothing is Today with extra steps

given: a read that answers no Property, or a viewer with no Property holding analytics
then: the first says so and links to Today; the second reads nothing and shows the not-available state the Analytics screen shows, so the page never names an Organization it was not asked about

given: several reached Properties, some withheld
then: one card per Property, in name order unless another order is asked for (PF-S4-01), a withheld Property included, under a summary of three figures: occupancy as counts, money owed per currency, and open maintenance

situation: Money the viewer may not read
given: a reader without finance.manage_folio or a Property with billing off
then: each card says Hidden with a lock where the amount would be, the summary tile says Hidden, and a notice explains it once no Property shows money. It is never 0 and never a dash that reads as nothing owed

given: a Property whose open Folios sum to nothing
then: it shows the currency's zero, which is a different statement from Hidden

situation: A figure whose module is off
given: a Property entitled to the portfolio without the maintenance capability
then: that figure says Not available and not Hidden, and a summary that adds it says it was counted at fewer Properties than are listed instead of understating silently

given: a reached Property without the analytics capability
then: its card is withheld whole with the reason, is kept in the list so it is not mistaken for missing, and can still be opened; withholding alone does not claim that money is hidden

given: Properties trading in lira and in euros
then: each card is written in its own currency and the summary keeps one line per currency, never one added figure

given: two Properties at 10 of 20 and 30 of 40
then: it reads 40 of 60 and a share of 66.7% worked out from those counts, not the average of 50% and 75%

given: a Property with no sellable units
then: it shows the counts and a No sellable units note and no percentage and no bar, because a share of nothing is not 0%

given: a card
then: the Property is remembered on this device as the switcher remembers it (OA-S3-05) and Today opens at it in a full load, which drops the client cache as ADR 0019 requires. Where Today is switched off at that Property Today chooses another one on its own, because the card does not know which destinations are open there

given: a Staff Member of two Organizations, and a URL naming a Property
then: the Organization that owns the Property in ?property= is read, written into the URL when it is bare, so the switcher and the page name the same one. Two Organizations are compared one at a time by choosing a Property in the other

situation: A Property named in the URL that is not reached
given: a forged or stale ?property=
then: nothing is read and the not-available state is shown, indistinguishable from a Property that does not exist (HK-S1-24)

given: an Organization reaching more than 200 Properties
then: a message with how many are reached and the most compared, and no cards: a comparison missing rows is worse than none (PF-S1-28)

given: a database error
then: the route's error boundary shows a retry in place of a blank workspace, logs the error in the browser, and the server has already recorded portfolio.viewed with outcome failed (PF-S1-34)

given: the read is in flight
then: shapes for the summary and the cards, aria-busy, and no number that claims to know the answer

given: Turkish, English and Arabic
then: the three catalogues carry the same keys and placeholders, Arabic is right to left, and every utility is logical so it mirrors

given: the page
then: it carries a back button to Today at the same Property (ADR 0035)
test_name: the back button leads to Today at the same Property

given: a 390 pixel wide screen
then: the cards stack in one column and the page never scrolls sideways
test_name: on a phone the cards stack and the page never scrolls sideways

given: the figures of one snapshot
then: it says the day and the time they were read and the time zone they are in, the working Property's own, so a comparison cannot be read as live and a tab left open overnight does not show yesterday at a plausible hour (PF-S4-06)

given: a viewer signed out between the Property list and the read
then: it shows the not-available state and not an empty portfolio

given: the workspace has no semantic-event sink
then: deferred: portfolio.viewed stays the structured console line PF-S1-34 describes and the screen adds only a console error when it fails to render; an Observatory sink is a change for the whole workspace and not this screen's

situation: Two Properties compared in a browser
given: an Owner reaching two Properties whose rooms, Guests in house, arrivals, departures, open maintenance and balances are known, in lira and in euros
then: both cards are on one page with the seeded figures, the summary is those cards added as counts with one money line per currency, and each card's figures equal what that Property's own Today shows
test_name: an Owner sets two Properties side by side and every figure on a card is the one that Property's own Today shows

situation: The comparison in Arabic in the browser
given: the same two Properties, read in Arabic
then: the page is right to left, each figure stays on its own Property's card, and the first Property sits at the right edge
test_name: the same comparison in Arabic keeps each figure with its Property and mirrors

situation: One Property is not offered the screen
given: a Manager who reaches one Property
when: they look at the rail and type the address of All Properties
then: the rail does not offer it; the address says there is nothing to compare, names the Property and links to Today at it; given a second Property with analytics the rail offers it
test_name: a viewer who reaches one Property is not offered All Properties and is told there is nothing to compare

given: a Manager who reaches two Properties, neither with the analytics capability
when: they look at the rail and type the address of All Properties
then: the rail does not offer it and the address shows the not-available state with no card
test_name: two Properties without Analytics are not offered All Properties either

given: many Properties and an order asked for in the address
then: the Properties are put in name, lowest occupancy, most owed, most open maintenance or most arrivals to come order, by link, kept in the address; a Property whose figure the viewer does not have goes last, never first as a zero; money is ordered within a currency and never across; no Property is marked behind (PORTFOLIO-01)
test_name: tests/unit/portfolio-view.test.tsx: puts the Property with the lowest occupancy first; tests/unit/portfolio-view.test.tsx: puts the most owed first, and one that hides money last, never first as a zero; tests/unit/portfolio-derive.test.ts: orders money within a currency and keeps the currencies apart

situation: A card leads with its share
given: a Property with sellable units
then: the share is the large figure with the count it is made of under it, a bar under that, and the measure is called Occupancy on the tile and on the card (PORTFOLIO-01, PORTFOLIO-07)
test_name: tests/unit/portfolio-view.test.tsx: shows the share as the large figure with the count under it, named the same on the tile and the card

situation: A figure opens the list behind it
given: a card or row with arrivals, departures, maintenance or money owed
then: the Property is remembered as Open does and the list opens at it, in a full load: arrivals, departures, maintenance, or finance narrowed to what is owing; a figure the viewer does not have is not a link (PORTFOLIO-04)
test_name: tests/unit/portfolio-view.test.tsx: links each figure to the list behind it at that Property, remembering it; tests/unit/portfolio-view.test.tsx: offers no link for a figure the viewer does not have

situation: The money tile says where it was counted
given: some Properties hide money and others show it
then: the money tile says it was counted at x of y Properties, as the occupancy and maintenance tiles do, and says nothing when it was counted at all of them (PORTFOLIO-02)
test_name: tests/unit/portfolio-view.test.tsx: says it was counted at one of two Properties when one hides money; tests/unit/portfolio-derive.test.ts: counts the money at the Properties that have a balance, of all that are listed

given: many Properties
then: each Property is a row with the same figures, nulls and links as its card, in the order chosen, kept in the address; Cards returns (PORTFOLIO-06)
test_name: tests/unit/portfolio-view.test.tsx: draws a row for each Property in the table, with the same figures and links; tests/browser/ux-money.spec.ts: the_properties_can_be_read_as_a_table_with_the_same_figures

given: a page left open
then: the figures are read again without a reload of the browser, and the stamp always carries the day, the time and the zone (PORTFOLIO-05)
test_name: tests/unit/portfolio-view.test.tsx: reads them again without leaving the page; tests/browser/ux-money.spec.ts: the_stamp_says_the_day_and_the_zone_and_refresh_reads_the_figures_again

given: an Owner with one Property
then: it says You have one Property, not that they reach it, and to ask an Owner if they should be assigned to another; folio is lower case in the money note (PORTFOLIO-07)

given: an Owner wants the Property that is behind marked
then: deferred: what behind means needs targets the product has none of, so nothing is marked behind and no target is invented; the order puts the lowest first (PORTFOLIO-01)

given: more Properties than the ceiling
then: deferred: there is nothing to filter by, since a Property has no region or group yet; the refusal stands (PF-S1-28, PORTFOLIO-06)

situation: One Property, told to the person who can add access
given: a viewer who reaches one Property and may give staff access to Properties
then: it says that Property is the only one they reach, and that if the Organization has another they give their account access to it in People, with a link to People; it does not tell them to ask an Owner. A role that cannot give access still is told to ask an Owner (FINANCE-15; PF-S4-07 for that role)
test_name: tests/unit/portfolio-view.test.tsx: FINANCE-15: one_property_tells_somebody_who_gives_staff_access_where_to_do_it_and_not_to_ask_an_owner; tests/unit/portfolio-view.test.tsx: FINANCE-15: one_property_offers_no_people_link_to_somebody_who_cannot_give_access; tests/browser/money-audit.spec.ts: an_owner_with_one_property_is_told_where_to_give_access_and_a_finance_role_is_told_to_ask; tests/browser/money-audit.spec.ts: a_role_that_cannot_give_access_is_still_told_to_ask_an_owner

situation: Money owed here is the bill only
given: a Property with in-house Guests whose nights no close has charged
when: the card's money owed is compared with Today's
then: deferred: PF-S1-20 sums positive Folio balances in the database function and leaves out the nights check-out will charge, which Today and Finance now include (FO-S11-01); aligning it is a migration, so it is the owner's to approve once (FINANCE-01)
